🎥🎬: Child’s Play (1988)

After being fatally wounded by police, serial killer Charles Lee Ray uses a voodoo ritual to transfer his soul into a Good Guy doll. The doll is purchased as a birthday present for young Andy Barclay, who quickly becomes attached to his new friend, Chucky.

But when people around Andy begin dying under mysterious circumstances, his mother Karen starts to suspect that the doll is somehow alive. As she uncovers the terrifying truth, Chucky begins revealing his true identity and desperately searches for a way to escape the doll and transfer his soul into a human body.

source_details.synopsis: Child's Play is a 1988 American supernatural slasher film directed by Tom Holland, from a screenplay he co-wrote with Don Mancini and John Lafia based on a story by Mancini. The film stars Catherine Hicks, Chris Sarandon, Alex Vincent, and Brad Dourif as Charles Lee Ray and the voice of Chucky. The plot follows a widowed mother who gives a new doll to her son, unaware that it is possessed by the soul of a serial killer. Child's Play was released in the United States on November 9, 1988, by MGM/UA Communications Co. through its United Artists label.
